messages:
michelle: quick q — for the auto-switchover UX, should the console surface the exact trigger (5xx spike vs latency vs token-queue) or keep it high-level? wondering about audit noise
ryan: +1 to surfacing triggers. operators need quick reason. maybe collapsible details so we don't freak out on every small spike
sylvia: prefer default collapsed. top-line: mode (soft/hard), active trigger, last triggered at. details panel with sampled traces, recent metrics and the decision path. e.g. show `error_rate > 0.05 over 30s`
michelle: good — what about operator overrides? should override create a permanent sticky exception or ephemeral (ttl)? also who can apply it?
jordan: ephemeral with reason required. make it create an audit event and optional rollback action. TTL = 1h default but editable. require `operator` role to apply
taylor: also need to show which routing policy ran (primary vs degraded model) and the exact model variant id. link to route config and the rollout that owns it
michelle: telemetry question — do we store full inputs/outputs for audit? security/reg teams will veto raw prompts for PII. my proposal: store hashed prompt id + a short evaluation snapshot (first 128 chars) and model logits metadata, with retention policy
ops-bot: incident created: #INC-4823 auto-switchover triggered on /generate (error_rate 7.2% in 00:02:15). Degrade mode: soft-defer -> routed to low-cost-quant model
kate-qa: QA asks: add a 'replay' button that runs a sampled set through the fallback path (sandbox) so we can run quick regression checks before marking as resolved
sylvia: UI sketch idea: big pill 'Auto-switchover: ON', small badge 'last trigger: 3m ago', expandable 'why' with bullets + sampled trace list and operator action buttons (Override / Pause / Create Issue). include copyable `decision_id` and breadcrumbs for audit
michelle: agree. next step — I'll draft a one-pager with the UI mock, API payloads and audit schema. pinging @ryan for API collar, @kate-qa for replay flow. thanks all :thumbsup:
